label: caiso 39 atc recal
definition: caiso-39 re-grounds the CAISO corridor forward-ATC parameters to the 3yr (2023-25) EIA-930 p95 import envelope. PNW COI atc_base_frac 0.30→0.44 (measured nighttime ceiling 2102 MW / 4800 MW TTC = 0.438), DSW Path-46 0.50→0.53 + solar_floor 0.30→0.65 (midday p95 avg 3694 MW / (10623×0.533) = 0.653; the desert-SW retains ~65% deliverability at peak solar saturation). Forward aggregate matches measured 2024 within 0.03 TWh. All caiso-38 offer-curve + seam levers carried verbatim. Headline: 2024 interchange error −5.46→−0.18 TWh, CA-zone LMP 85.7/57.1/62.5→82.1/54.1/58.3 $/MWh (2023/24/25; actual 43.8/33.0/33.6). The ATC was the discovered structural bug from caiso-38; the remaining ~$21 body residual is the structurally-real CA-CC SRMC floor ($50-55 = gas×HR + CARB + VOM vs actual $33 set by cheaper imports/hydro half the time). 2025 over-import (−6.91 TWh) driven by hydro budget shortfall (model 12.3 vs actual 21.3 TWh) — separate mechanism.
